claims.claim: Fitting a preprocessing transform before splitting can leak information from held-out observations into training.
claims.notes: Fit learned transformations only on the training partition or training fold.

claims.claim: A Pipeline composes transformations and an estimator so each cross-validation training fold fits its own preprocessing state.
claims.notes: External feature extraction and temporal availability still require separate controls.

claims.claim: Imputation replaces missing values using a defined strategy; missingness indicators may preserve information about absence.
claims.notes: The best strategy depends on missingness mechanism and deployment distribution.

claims.claim: Scaling parameters such as means and standard deviations are learned from training data and reused unchanged at inference.
claims.notes: Scaling is not universally necessary for tree-based estimators.
